styleLock.backgroundSystem: clean white #FFFFFF for the packshot, dreamy light-blue gradients #DCE9F7 to #CFE0F5 for benefit and mechanism screens, airy near-white blue #F5F8FC for infographic screens, deep sea blue #2E5FA3 reserved for the closing screen

styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent dreamy aqua skincare visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of pearl white #FFFFFF, misty light blue #DCE9F7, deep sea blue accent #2E5FA3 and silver-grey highlight #C9D6E8; soft diffused glow lighting with pearlescent highlights and soft contact shadows only; modern geometric sans-serif with deep blue headlines on light panels; thin rounded line icons and frosted glass circles; clean high-end skincare photography mixed with minimal infographic elements; the bottle always upright or gently floating, stable scale, single hero object; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 逐屏事实：P1 梦幻蓝底悬浮瓶+圆形成分徽标+底部四枚图标；P2 痛点卡（ headline+胶囊条+三张灰色习惯卡）+双勾选卖点；P3 光环机制屏（三枚磨砂圆位，含数值宣称）；P4 滴管气泡微距+三枚成分气泡球+三步骤 01/02/03；P5 三步骤空卡+白色参数卡（品牌/系列/产地/肤质/功效/规格六行）+瓶身；P6 问答区与会员角标、二维码贴片。品类判定：源夹名为「洗护」，但 P5 参数卡明示系列为海洋面部精华、功效与肤质均针对面部，硬证据为参数区品名与使用部位，判定为护肤个护/面部护理而非洗护发。已剥离：原品牌与系列字样、全部原文案原句、成分名与全部数值（含量、倍数、道数、年份、容量等一律改 {callout_n}/{selling_point_n} 或空白占位）、功效与认证类宣称一律不作为事实写入、模特无、会员角标与二维码贴片删除、问答具体文字删除。源页功效类说法相互重叠且含大量数值断言，两种以上矛盾说法均未写入。
